_comment: COST NOTE: the Ad Library actor bills per AD, and dedup only removes duplicate LEADS *after* you've paid to scrape the ads. So heavily-overlapping queries (e.g. 'christian life coach' + 'faith based life coach' + 'christian business coach') re-pay for the same advertisers. Keep this list SHORT and DISTINCT — a few broad, non-overlapping terms cover the niche, and the faithSignal scoring surfaces the faith ones. Add more only if daily net-new leads drop off. Each query fetches ~overfetch× maxResults ads.
